sellerSteps: Share the land or property, the location and what you are trying to achieve.
Our team understands the asset and identifies the right route — sale, lease, aggregation or joint venture.
Relevant property information is structured, with professional coordination where documents or valuation are involved.
We agree how the opportunity is presented and which part of the network it goes to.
The opportunity moves to relevant buyers, investors or developers, with support through the discussion.
